repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR checks if the volume dropped (v1 - v2 >= 20), but the JoI checks if it rose (v2 - v1 >= 20). Evidence F2 shows the JoI incorrectly triggered the action when the volume increased from 0 to 20, whereas the IR would not have triggered.
diagnosis.change_summary: Corrected the subtraction order in the `if` condition from `v2 - v1` to `v1 - v2` to match the IR's logic for detecting a volume drop.
